clips.title: The story
paras: Raynewood Retreat watches the northern approaches to Felwood from a great tree in Ashenvale. Dryads and Cenarion protectors guard the outpost, where Keeper Ordanus makes his home.

At Raynewood Retreat, the great tree rises between Shael'dryn's moonwell and the satyr-infested ruins of Night Run. Cenarion Protectors, faerie dragons, and Laughing Sisters guard the outpost. Their watch turns north, toward the taint spreading from Felwood.
